sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "budget"."link_to_event" AS e, SUM("budget"."amount") AS m1, AVG("budget"."spent") AS m2, (SUM("budget"."amount") - AVG("budget"."spent")) AS m3 FROM "budget" GROUP BY "budget"."link_to_event") SELECT SUM("s1"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s1"."m2") AS m2, AVG("s1"."m3") AS m3 FROM "s1"

average of amount spent in category per event (by link_to_event)

coarsen to all: SUM (additive), AVG (averaged), AVG (averaged)
